actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.extract.description: Use AI to pull specific data from a webpage — pricing, specs, contacts, and more.
actions.extract.props.prompt.description: What information to extract (e.g. "list all pricing tiers with features").
actions.extract.props.url.description: The URL to extract information from.
actions.fetch.description: Fetch URLs and return clean markdown. Supports web pages, PDFs, and documents.
actions.fetch.props.include_raw_html.des: Also include the raw HTML source in each result (null for non-HTML content such as PDFs).
actions.research.description: Research any topic — searches up to 30 sources and synthesizes a cited report.
actions.research.props.freshness.descrip: Filter by recency: "day", "week", "month", "year", or a range "YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD".
actions.research.props.max_sources.descr: Maximum number of sources to use (5-30).
actions.research.props.topic.description: Use "news" to prioritize recent news articles.
actions.search.description: Search the web and get full page content, not just snippets.
actions.search.props.freshness.descripti: Filter by recency: "day", "week", "month", "year", or a range "YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD".
actions.search.props.include_answer.desc: Add an AI-synthesized answer based on the search results (adds 5 credits).
actions.search.props.include_domains.des: Only include results from these domains (max 10).
actions.search.props.search_depth.descri: "basic" fetches pages and returns extracted content (3 credits). "snippets" returns SERP snippets only, without fetching pages (1 credit).
actions.search.props.topic.description: Use "news" for current events, breaking news, or any time-sensitive query.
auth.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Sofya API Key:

1. Visit [Sofya](https://sofya.co) and create an account (sign up with GitHub for 1,000 free credits per month on most accounts).
2. Open your [dashboard](https://sofya.co/dashboard).
3. Copy your API key (it starts with `ay_live_`).
description: Web tools for AI agents: search the web, fetch pages as clean markdown, extract structured data with AI, and run deep multi-source research.
